paper.title_en: New Improved Schwarzschild Black Hole and Its Thermodynamics and Topological Classification
paper.abstract_en: We construct a renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild-like black hole geometry using the exact new scheme running for the Newton coupling. The scale identification is implemented via a standard interpolating proper-distance function governed by an interpolation parameter $γ$ that smoothly connects the ultraviolet and infrared regimes. We present the resulting coordinate-dependent coupling and the improved metric function, analyzing its asymptotic expansions. The large-distance limit is shown to recover the classical Schwarzschild solution, while for $γ>0$ the short-distance behavior exhibits a regular de Sitter-like core, resulting in the regularization of the central singularity. We also analyze the thermodynamic properties of the solution, showing that quantum corrections significantly modify the small-radius behavior, leading to a remnant configuration and a nontrivial phase structure. Finally, we investigate the thermodynamic topology of the improved Schwarzschild black hole and show that the quantum-gravity corrections regularize the Hawking-temperature profile, giving rise to an additional thermodynamic defect with opposite winding number and changing the global thermodynamic-topological charge from the classical Schwarzschild value $W=-1$ to $W=0$.
